description: Rothco's M.O.L.L.E. Tactical Laptop Briefcase is designed for those who need durability and functionality in their everyday carry. Constructed from rugged 600 Denier Polyester with a PVC coated lining, this briefcase ensures your gear stays protected in any environment. The large main compartment features a secure flap and a removable padded sleeve specifically designed to keep your laptop safe during transport. Additionally, the briefcase includes a zippered file and organizer compartment complete with an ID holder, making it easy to keep your documents and essentials organized. The exterior is equipped with M.O.L.L.E. loops on the back and 3 detachable M.O.L.L.E. pouches on the front, allowing for customized storage solutions. For added convenience, the briefcase features a sturdy carry handle and an adjustable padded shoulder strap, providing comfort during long commutes. Whether you're heading to the office or out in the field, Rothco's M.O.L.L.E. Tactical Laptop Briefcase offers the ultimate combination of style, durability, and functionality.
